Give me a reason not to hate Entrati
And the whole damn future you come from

Because as far as I can tell

true
Check boolean LettieEntrati
false
I don't disagree. I hate Entrati as much as you do. But the future is worth fighting for, even if it'd be better without him in it.
Entrati isn't all bad, he's trying to fix his mistakes. And anybody who's capable of love has something worth saving in them, IMO.
Yikes. I know when a conversation is going to go poorly. I'm out. [End.]
And none of this "greater good" pendejadas
And your whole stinking future can get screwed as far as I'm concerned
true

false
He is TRASH
And the future is TRASH
Love?
Who could possibly love someone like that
Chat ends.
I'm from the future. Do you think I'm trash?
Just because you hate one guy doesn't mean the whole future is garbage.
His name's Loid. Sort of a... workplace romance, you could say.
He had a family. Wife, kids, grandkids now.
it may not be ugly to you
But it is WRONG
It is not what the gods intended
He tampered with it all
¿Ay, sí?
I did not see Loid here with him
You said HAD
What do you mean, HAD
Check boolean LettieReligion2
Loid is still in the future, guarding Entrati's lab. He's been there for centuries.
Entrati abandoned Loid like he abandons everybody.
Well, the issue is, his daughter thinks he's lost, and is searching for him. It's complicated.
I mean, I'm sure he loved them at one point...
I've got a warning light going off in - um - I have to go. [End.]
If he never angered Xipe Totec, this Man in the Wall, none of your future would exist
true
If he never unleashed this Man in the Wall, none of your future would exist
false

Update boolean LettieEntratiFamily

Used and tossed away
I bet not the first time he's done it
¿Verdad?
He abandoned his family
Let me guess
He's done it another time hasn't he
The void would not have been unleashed, ¿no?
Duviri would never have been made
Your life would have been happier
true
The void would not have been unleashed, ¿no?
You never would have been trapped
Your life would have been happier
false
Check boolean LettieCavia
Check boolean LettieCavia
There's no way of knowing what could have been. In fact, without the Tenno, all of humanity might be gone by now, wiped out by the Sentients.
You're right, but I can't change what's been done. Not at that scale. I'm doing my best to save who and what I can.
Yeah... he abandoned his family. He had a wife, kids, and now grandkids.
true
Look, it doesn't matter. He doesn't define the future.
true
Yeah... he abandoned the Cavia, the animals he experimented on and accidentally made intelligent.
false
true
false

true

This is not your fault and you are not garbage

A synthetic race made by the Orokin and the future human society to terraform a planet called Tau, because we were ruining Earth.
A synthetic race made by the Orokin and future human society who waged war on us after they were made.
You are like me
Just a medic keeping as many lives from joining La Flaca too early as possible
More mortals playing at being gods

More mortals playing at being gods
These orokin are trash

Update boolean LettieReligion3
Because the Orokin sent them there to terraform a new planet, Tau, and the Sentients were worried that we'd ruin that one, too.
Because they're just as egotistical, violent, and evil as the Orokin.
Father and Mother? You mean Sol and Lua?
Sol and Lua aren't gods, Lettie... they're just a star and a rock...
De tal palo, tal astilla
Humans making a race in their image
Thinking they are the Father and Mother
Disgusting
Sí
They are something special, deep down, something more to us than just what they are at first glance
Sí

And you are just a person with nothing special about them except what was done to them
Do you believe in the unseen, ¿babas?
Do you believe in something beyond the world we can measure?

I've told you already, I don't believe in anything.
true
No. If you can't measure it, it doesn't exist.
false

false

false

How small your world must feel
